LCAnomalyCore.Defs.AbnormalityCodexEntry.label: Notes from a Crazed Researcher
LCAnomalyCore.Defs.AbnormalityCodexEntry.description: Notes from a Crazed Researcher (T-09-78) is an equippable HE Tool Abnormality.\nIts mad insights boost work and abnormality research speed by +50%, but taking 100 cumulative damage or returning it before 30s and 1 study causes a lethal explosion.
